name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo Rodriguez's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with his father. This early fascination led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. Upon graduation, he started his career at a smaller racing team, gaining invaluable hands-on experience in all aspects of car setup and maintenance. His talent and dedication quickly propelled him through the ranks.

Known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving and unwavering focus on optimizing performance, Mateo excels at bridging the gap between engineering data and driver feedback. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member's input is valued, leading to innovative solutions and continuous improvement. He joined Manthey EMA hoping to prove himself on the international stage.

Mateo sets himself apart with his ability to quickly identify and address critical performance bottlenecks. He is known for his cool head under pressure and his relentless pursuit of perfection. His skill is not just about extracting performance from the car, but also about building a cohesive and highly motivated engineering team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Mateo is of average height, with a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race day with a strong cup of mate.
